title: Import and export
subtitle: Bring spreadsheets in, take lists out. Imports are checked for duplicates first and every one is kept in the history below.
deniedBody: Importing needs the leads.import permission. Your role ({role}) does not have it. Ask a workspace owner.
deniedSupport: Imports and exports are not available in a support session.
demoBanner: Demo workspace: this runs on sample data and saves nothing.
fileHint: CSV or XLSX, up to {mb} MB and {rows} rows. The first row must be the column names.
sampleNote: Sample rows are built in. Nothing is uploaded or saved.
tooBig: That file is over {mb} MB. Split it and import the parts one by one.
unsupported: Only .csv and .xlsx files can be imported.
emptyFile: That file has no data rows.
tooManyRows: That file has more than {rows} rows. Split it into smaller files.
tooManyColumns: That file has more than {cols} columns. Remove the ones you do not need.
unreadable: That file could not be read. Save it again as CSV or XLSX and retry.
uploadFailed: The upload failed. Nothing was imported. Try again.
mapDesc: {rows} rows found. Pick where each column goes. Columns set to Ignore are not imported.
duplicateTargets: Each field can come from one column only. Fix: {fields}
savedMappingUsed: Your saved column mapping was applied.
saveMapping: Remember this mapping for next time
mappingNotSaved: The mapping was not saved, the import can still continue.
dupRule: Duplicates match on email, phone number (E.164) or, for accounts, name and city.
dupHandling: When a row duplicates an existing record
dupSkip: Skip it and keep the existing record
dupMerge: Merge: fill the existing record with the values from the file
problemsNote: Rows with problems are not imported. You can download them with the reason after the import.
importRows: Import {n, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
queued: Queued. The import starts in a moment.
failedBody: The file could not be processed. Nothing further was written. Check the file and try again.
errorReportFailed: The problem report could not be downloaded.
startFailed: The import could not be started.
demoResult: Demo preview: {fresh} would be added, {dup} duplicates, {invalid} problems.
histEmpty: No imports yet. Your imports will be listed here with their results.
histEmptyDemo: Demo workspace: imports are not recorded.
histLoadError: The import history could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
exportDesc: Downloads a CSV of the current records you are allowed to see. Every export is written to the audit log.
exportMaskForced: Personal data is masked in this file because your role cannot see it in full.
exportDone: Exported {n, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
exportDoneMasked: Personal data is masked in the file.
exportDoneOpen: Personal data is included in full.
exportEmpty: There is nothing to export in that list.
exportTruncated: The file is limited to the first {n} rows. Narrow the list and export again.
exportSupport: Exports are not available in a support session.
exportFailed: The export could not be created. Nothing was downloaded.

reasons.contact_required: Add an email or a phone number so this record can be reached.
reasons.email_invalid: The email address is not valid.
reasons.phone_invalid: The phone number is not valid. Use the country code, for example +91.
reasons.number_invalid: The value is not a number.
reasons.date_invalid: The date is not valid. Use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.
reasons.choice_invalid: The value is not one of the allowed options.
reasons.url_invalid: The web address is not valid.
reasons.duplicate_in_file: This row repeats an earlier row in the same file.
reasons.write_failed: The record could not be saved. It may conflict with an existing record.
